label: CARD-NLR subtilase system
definition: A CARD-NLR system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder CARD_NLR_Subtilase subtype locus represented by the CARD_NLR_Subtilase rule row requiring the CARD_NLR__Subtilase_long_new profile.
observations: CARD-NLR subtilase branch under CARD-NLR system; distinct from the broader CARD-NLR system, CARD_NLR_GasderMIN, CARD_NLR_Endonuclease, CARD_NLR_Phospho, or CARD_NLR_like subtypes, individual CARD-like, NLR-like, Trypsin, or subtilase-family proteins, exact subtilase substrates, phage triggers, native host breadth, unresolved CARD-to-subtilase activation, DefenseFinder HMM rows, the missing CARD_NLR__Subtilase_long_new HMM inventory row, and other phage-defense systems.
